profile_text.body:
Uber Technologies, Inc. is a publicly traded company (ticker UBER) headquartered in San Francisco, California, with SEC filings under CIK 0001543151. On its own site, the company describes the Uber platform and apps as tools for earning, eating, commuting, getting a ride, and simplifying business travel.

The site also states that Uber is introducing autonomous vehicles to its platform, describing this as a reimagining of movement with autonomous vehicles as a key part of the future. Uber says it is partnering with industry leaders and taking a safety-driven approach intended to combine autonomous vehicles and drivers for a best-in-class experience.

The company's litigation record shows 281 cases in California. No AI products or MCP servers are tracked for Uber in the data reviewed.
